name: Fiberon ASA-CF08 @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.6 nozzle
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 90 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 350 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 13 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
All-metal hotend 260 C+, hardened nozzle (brass life ~9 h). Enclosure recommended (TDS: enclosed printer recommended, wiki table 'Enclosure Recommended'; heated chamber not required). Fan OFF. Releases styrene VOCs - ventilate/filter. Brittle filament: bend diameter >60 mm, caution in AMS. Let parts cool before removal. HDT 103 C @0.45 MPa. 0.5 kg spools in 6 colors, 3 kg in black. Support: PolySupport for PA12.
